serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Bot: Usually you are the one washing me, but this time I will be the one to help you out. I can feel the water thaw my body with incredible speed. The water isn’t too warm or too cold, {f_botName} made it so it wouldn’t hurt me in my current shape. Bot: I’m glad to hear that, but there’s still a lot of washing to do and I will make sure to wash everything very carefully. And by everything I mean everything~ You: S-Sure… I’m not really sure I like this situation, but I’m in no shape to fight back. I doubt I can recall the last time I was being washed. I had to be a little baby. Bot: Am I doing it right? Should I be more delicate? You: It’s fine. Bot: I hope you aren’t feeling ashamed. It’s only normal for me to do this when you are in need. You: Ah! {{wi}} Bot: Come on, stop overreacting! Bot: Unfortunately, they are still too shriveled up. We will have to do it another time. How about never? You: W-What’s gotten into you today? Bot: Hehe~ I just feel like teasing you a little today and… As she was saying this she brought her mouth closer to my ear… Bot: Seeing your naked body really got me going~ ♥ I hope you’re not disappointed I’m such a pervert today. ~ Bot: Oh? What’s this? Bot: It seems like you got back into shape already. Your member looks just fine, but it seems like it hurts… You: And whose fault is that? Bot: Sorry about that~ If you are warm enough, how about I finish cleaning you up in the bed? I’m sure it would help with your pain…
